buttons: Control whether your featured listing statuses (active, pending, sold) update automatically from your MLS feed.
Choose whether your sold featured listings appear on the Featured Listings page or only on the Sold Featured Listings page. This includes any sold featured listings in the last 2 years.

Displaying pending listings on other pages can provide additional exposure since Featured Listings can display in multiple places throughout your site (e.g. listing galleries, widgets, gallery sliders, and slideshows)

Supplemental listings are manually added listings not in your MLS IDX feed (e.g., pocket listings or out-of-board listings). You may only add listings you or your brokerage represent — adding others' listings may violate your real estate board's advertising rules.
labels:
Automatically sync featured listing statuses with MLS

If disabled, listing statuses must be updated manually and sold listings appear only if provided by your MLS. Must be enabled for your co-listings and buyer's agent to appear on your sold listings, when provided by your MLS.

Show sold listings on Featured Listings Page

Sold featured listings already display on your Sold Featured Listings page, enable to also display on your Featured Listings Page.

Display supplemental listings on Featured Listings Page

Enable to also display supplemental listings on the Featured Listings Page. When disabled, supplemental listings will only display on the dedicated Supplemental Listings page.
